sun.swing.plaf.synth

类 StyleAssociation

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.swing.plaf.synth.StyleAssociation

  • public class StyleAssociation
extends Object
    WARNING: This class is an implementation detail and is only public so that it can be used by two packages. You should NOT consider this public API.

    StyleAssociation is used to lookup a style for a particular component (or region).

    作者:
    Scott Violet
